summary.headline: Phemex snapshot 20261101 is Stage 0: permissionless porVersions balances → computed reserve ratios; monthly Merkle inclusion and cold-wallet addresses appear on the public PoR UI, but merkle root / wallet-addresses APIs are CloudFront-gated and user proofs stay login-gated.
summary.rationale: solvency-claim PASS means chainBalance/cexBalance ratios from https://por.phemex.com/porVersions only. UI shows Part of Our Cold Wallets and a Merkle self-check, but there is no permissionless wallet zip, no public period merkle root in the archived package, and no official OSS verifier — Stage 1 walletZip/ownership/ZK stay unwired.
